name: La Chaux-de-Fonds / Le Locle, Watchmaking Town Planning
description: High in the Swiss Jura mountains, La Chaux-de-Fonds and Le Locle are two neighbouring towns built almost entirely around watchmaking. After fires in the early 1800s, both were rebuilt on a grid of parallel strips where homes and workshops sit side by side. Walking their streets, you see a working watch country that Karl Marx called a "huge factory-town," and Le Locle's museum and castle trace the craft back to the 1600s.
